body: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) has been driven largely by scaling model size and human-curated training data, yet this paradigm is increasingly constrained by data scarcity and diminishing returns from human supervision. Self-play offers a promising pathway for autonomous data generation and improvement, but current frameworks remain unsatisfactory due to a lack of a data-centric perspective, limited cross-domain generalization, and growing trustworthiness and security concerns. In this paper, we argue that real-world LLM self-play systems should achieve effectiveness, generalizability, and trustworthiness under data scarcity. To address these challenges, we outline three blue-sky research directions for future self-play systems: (1) data-centric self-play for effective experience generation, (2) generalizable self-play for open-world and unverifiable tasks, and (3) trustworthy self-play for reliable self-evolution. We further discuss research opportunities and solutions within each direction. This paradigm shift will establish a sustainable and safe AI ecosystem by transforming finite human knowledge into inexhaustible high-quality experience through self-play architectures.
summaryZh: 数据稀缺下的 LLM 自我博弈：有效性、通用性和可信度。大型语言模型 (LLM) 的快速发展很大程度上是由扩展模型大小和人工训练数据驱动的，但这种范式越来越受到数据稀缺和人类监督回报递减的限制。自我对弈为自主数据生成和改进提供了一条有前途的途径，但由于缺乏以数据为中心的视角、有限的跨域泛化以及日益增长的可信度和安全问题，当前的框架仍然不能令人满意。
